text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I passed behind the school building,
Air Groove and Seiun Sky were
watering the flower bed together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Well, well, you've come by at just the right time~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you look rather exhausted.
Being a Trainer is tough work, isn't it?
Whiiiich is why~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How about we water the flowers together?
It's very soothing to the soul~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sky. You really are...
Trying to slickly dump your own work onto others again, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you saw right through me, huh?
Man, watering plants really is tough work~...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, I do have to fetch water several times,
and the academy's flowerbeds are vast. It takes some effort.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can't we make this a little easier~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Why not just use a drone
to spray water from above all at once?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cease this at once!
Honestly, don't try to cut corners every chance you get.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Besides, some plants will actually wither if water gets on their flowers or leaves."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh~... Now that's another huge pain.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright, if you understand, move your hands instead of your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You came here intending to be a "substitute," didn't you?
Those planters over there are her responsibility.
Make sure you see at least that through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'Substitute'? 'That girl'? Hearing Air Groove's words
and seeing Seiun Sky return to work unusually obediently, it suddenly occurred to me——"
choice_data_list: Why are you the one watering them in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you see, Sei-chan is a kind-heeearted
horse girl who just can't leave
a beautification committee member in trouble, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This too must be fate. Sky, feel free to come water the flowers regularly from now on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I especially recommend it during the daisy season.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whenever you feel like it, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! Gosh, what a mess!!
Yay, then I leave it to you~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey!! Geez, you really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, but seriously,
working yourself to the bone isn't good either~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there anything we can simplify?
From what Sei-chan can see—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're certainly thinking about this quite deeply, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. You want to lighten the burden
on the Beautification Committee, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, not at all. I just like
coming up with ways to take it easy~."
